4000Plus Bondtester
Product catalog summary
Overview: The Nordson DAGE 4000Plus is an advanced bondtester known for its precision and versatility, suitable for industries like semiconductors and microelectronics. It builds on the success of the Nordson DAGE 4000, ensuring reliable data correlation.
Specifications: The bondtester features a variety of XY stages ranging from 160mm x 160mm to 300mm x 210mm, with options for high precision, speed, and heated work stages up to 400°C. It supports testing weights from 250 milligrams to 500kg, catering to both standard and specialized applications.
Testing Capabilities: The 4000Plus can perform numerous tests such as ribbon pull, hot bump/pin pull, fatigue pull and shear, and passivation layer shear. It is highly configurable with different load cartridges and optics for various applications.
Data Integrity and Correlation: The system ensures data traceability and integrity, calibrated to international standards. It features automatic load tool alignment and supports data correlation between old and new machines, facilitated by Paragon™ software.
Efficiency and Imaging: The bondtester includes an image capture system for high-resolution failure mode analysis and fiducial alignment. It offers various camera systems, including borescope and trinocular cameras, for precise tool alignment and testing.
Software and Compatibility: The 4000Plus uses Paragon™ software, providing advanced functionality and reporting capabilities. It is compatible with existing Nordson DAGE equipment, reducing downtime and ownership costs.
Industry Standards: The bondtester adheres to numerous industry standards, including JEITA, JEDEC, ASTM, and MIL STD, ensuring compliance and reliability in testing.
Conclusion: The Nordson DAGE 4000Plus is a leading bondtester, recognized for its precision, versatility, and reliability, supported by a global network and continuous investment in research and development.
